title: Saving an edit shows the new name and Due text in the row
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has an unused term of its own and changes its name and when it is due.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 10 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-20 Ten.
  • A new name {Term-B} that no term has.
    For example: {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-20 Fifteenth.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. Replace the Name with {Term-B}.
  4. Click the Day box.
  5. Type 15 in the Day box.
  6. Click "Save Changes".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the "Edit Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 3: the Name reads {Term-B}.
  • Step 4: "Due day of the following month" is chosen and Days is emptied.
  • Step 5: the blue information line shows below the options.
  • Step 6: the window closes, the green toast "{Term-B} saved" shows, and the row now reads {Term-B} with Due "15th of the following month", listed after the Net terms.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R8: “On Save Changes, the window closes, a success toast shows "{name} saved", and the row shows the new name and Due text.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit term edited and saved | "{name} saved" | Success toast”
  • Story 3, Error Handling: “On Create, a success toast shows "{name} created". On Save Changes, a success toast shows "{name} saved". Both are the same green toast as the page's other actions.”
